integrity: The complete global minimization proof is analytic. Exact-rational finite checks supplement rather than replace the proof. Novelty assessment is limited to inspected sources; independently certified originality is not asserted.
scientific_limitations: Signed affine two-stage population-response approximation; independent, centered finite-variance additive shocks; exact stationary moments, fixed demographic replacement margin, constant fertility and noise levels. Not a nonnegative population process or a field-tested harvest prescription.
title: Sharp noise-route threshold for age-specific risk allocation in a two-stage population
